meta.name: Haneul Tower
meta.axes: x east, y up, z south (plan [x, z]); north is -z
meta.heights: wall and opening y values are relative to their floor level; [x, y, z] points are absolute (F1 floor = 0)
meta.setting: Seoul, 2111, rainy night near midnight; a fictional mixed-use supertall on the north bank of the river
meta.revision: v2: competitive critique applied (see DESIGN.md section 11)

reinforce.header: hard steel transom from 2.0 m to the ceiling
reinforce.budget_rule: per defending team per round; any wall unit or hatch counts 1
reinforce.placement: units sit on the clear defender face, centred in reinforce.clear, with >= trim of hard jamb at each end

hard.desc: indestructible: core, columns, shear/stone walls, slabs, spandrels

soft.desc: drywall partition, floor to ceiling; bullets and charges make holes

reinforceable.desc: soft panel zone 0..2.0 m sized for Wall Fortification units; hard transom/header above 2.0 m

balustrade.desc: 1.1 m tempered glass rail at void edges and walkways; shoot and vault over

hatch.desc: 1.2 x 1.2 m breakable floor panel; wall-fortification-hatch fits it

soft_floor.desc: destructible floor/ceiling patch for vertical shots

window_barricadable.desc: window/entry opening that takes a barricade

opening.desc: archway, vault counter, pried lift door: never barricaded

glass_breakable.desc: curtain-wall lite that shatters (sightline; entry from a ledge or rappel)

portal.desc: bridge portal frame with a barricadable double door

pilaster.desc: 0.3 m hard pilaster where two reinforceable walls of one room meet

holo.desc: hologram volume: blocks vision, not bullets; its emitter ring is destructible

zone_ext.desc: exterior defender reveal zone (trigger volume, no geometry)
